apiPrefix.description: The path of the service's API every call the screens make stands under.

bundle.description: The path of the service's API the bundle's module is answered at.

calls.description: The other services the screens call through the console, each by the service name its own manifest gives it, or people, the company's members the console answers itself.

events.description: Whether the screens read the service's event stream.

formerScreenPaths.description: The paths the bundle's screens stood under before; a console answers every address under one as moved to the screen path.

items.description: A path the bundle's screens stood under before.

icon.description: The icon drawn beside the screen's name.

layer.description: The version of the layer the bundle was built on, as the bundle build wrote it.

name.description: The bundle's name: its words' namespace.

ownerKey.description: Whether every call the screens make needs the reader's owner key.

pushKinds.description: The event kinds a console may raise as a notice to a reader not on the screen.

pushPlaces.description: The place on the screen a notice of a kind under pushKinds opens, by kind: a path pattern at or below the screen path, its placeholders filled from the event's member.

role.description: The role every reader the notice rings holds.

field.description: The member's field holding the account key of the one reader the notice rings.

pushReaders.description: The readers a notice of a kind under pushKinds rings, by kind: those holding a role, or the one account a field of the event's member names; every reader the manifest's role allows where a kind names none.

relays.description: The service's own routes outside the API prefix that a console relays as well.

path.description: The route's whole path on the service's API.

role.description: The least role a reader holds to open the screen.

screenPath.description: The path the bundle's screens stand under.

serviceName.description: The service's name, which the console relays it under; never people, the name the console answers the company's members under itself.

shareHead.description: The read a console asks for what a share address reads as before it is opened: a path pattern under the API prefix holding {token} once.

shareReads.description: The reads a share token alone permits: path patterns under the API prefix, each holding {token} once.

sidebarSection.description: The section of a console's sidebar the bundle's entry stands in: administration, among the services an administrator runs the system with, application, among the applications a reader works in, or account, in the reader's own menu.

sidebarSections.description: The section the entry stands in for a reader by the role they hold, where it is not the sidebarSection: each key a role, each value a section.

sidebarUnread.description: The route a console reads a sidebar unread count from, and the field of its answer that holds it.

field.description: The answer's field holding the count, a whole number nought or more.

path.description: The path of the service's API the count is answered at.

stylesheet.description: The path of the service's API the bundle's stylesheet is answered at.

title.description: The key, in the bundle's words, its screen is named by in the console's menu; under the bundle's namespace.

websocket.description: Whether the screens open a WebSocket to the service.

words.description: The path of the service's API the bundle's words are answered at.
